entities.summary: Ryan Bradley Spooner is a Canadian professional ice hockey forward who is currently playing for Lausanne HC of the National League (NL). He has previously played in the National Hockey League (NHL) for the Boston Bruins, New York Rangers, Edmonton Oilers, and Vancouver Canucks. He was selected by the Boston Bruins in the second round, 45th overall, of the 2010 NHL Entry Draft.
